title: AI Builders Digest
subtitle: Bilingual edition · 双语对照版

intro.text: 今天的 feed 里，最值得注意的不是又多了多少 AI 功能，而是大家开始重新设计“怎么用”和“怎么组织”。从 OpenAI 试图把 ChatGPT 变简单，到 Granola 接受用户绕过 UI 直接调用 MCP，再到 Sequence 用长期持有和工程团队重做传统企业，AI 正在从一个工具层问题，变成产品、组织和商业模式的重构问题。

archive.title: 组织重构日报
archive.desc: AI 的下一阶段不是堆更多功能，而是把产品入口、企业组织和基础设施一起改造成适合 agent 工作的形状。

footerNote: Source: Follow Builders curated daily digest. Rebuilt from the 2026-10-06 source feeds.

sections.title: Simpler Interfaces, Deeper Integrations / 更简单的界面，更深的连接
sections.desc: 当 agent 成为主要入口，产品不一定要让用户看见更多界面，反而要让它更容易进入真实工作流。

rewrite: Peter Yang thinks ChatGPT has become too complicated and argues that OpenAI should simplify the product surface: Work vs. Codex, Spaces vs. Pages vs. Sites, and the model and effort picker are all competing for attention. His sharper take is that the Work launch may have been a branding mistake, and that the primary AI harness should absorb the useful parts instead of multiplying product concepts.
original:
I'm glad OpenAI is focusing on simplifying ChatGPT because it has become a mess (sorry).

Here's a clip from my dots review about this. What I'd simplify:

1. Work vs. Codex
2. Spaces vs. Pages vs. Sites
3. The model and effort picker
Probably alot more

My hot take is that the whole Work launch was a mistake. Just like Claude folded Cowork back into Chat, I don't think Work needs its own brand.

Anyway, excited to see my primary harness get much better.

📌 See my full dots review here: https://t.co/kUtg3RPk7l

rewrite: Peter Yang 认为 ChatGPT 已经变得过于复杂，应该重新简化产品表面：Work 和 Codex、Spaces 和 Pages 和 Sites，以及 model 和 effort 选择器，都在争夺用户注意力。他更尖锐的判断是，Work 这个发布可能从一开始就不该成为独立品牌，真正重要的能力应该回到用户每天使用的主 harness 里。
original:
我很高兴 OpenAI 开始专注于简化 ChatGPT，因为它已经变得一团乱（抱歉）。

我会简化这些东西：
1. Work 和 Codex
2. Spaces、Pages 和 Sites
3. model 和 effort 选择器
可能还有很多。

我的 hot take 是，Work 整个发布都是个错误。就像 Claude 把 Cowork 放回 Chat 一样，我觉得 Work 不需要独立品牌。

总之，很期待我的主要 harness 变得更好。

rewrite: Granola co-founder Sam has made peace with users skipping Granola's UI and reaching its context through their own internal agents. For enterprise software, this is an important product lesson: the winning interface may be the company's existing workflow, while the product's job is to capture context and make it available wherever work already happens.
original:
But as soon as you become a big enough enterprise, it's inevitable you have all of this internal tooling. If Granola doesn't play nice with that internal tooling, then it's a non-starter.

At this point we're at peace with the fact that for a bunch of workflows, the best way to use Granola is to capture the context, then use it through your internal agent.

rewrite: Granola 联合创始人 Sam 已经接受：用户可能不会打开 Granola 的 UI，而是通过公司自己的 internal agent 调用 Granola 捕获的上下文。对企业软件来说，这是一个很关键的产品教训：最好的界面可能就是企业原有的工作流，产品真正要做的是把上下文捕获下来，并送到工作发生的地方。
original:
但企业一旦足够大，就不可避免会有各种内部工具。如果 Granola 不能和这些内部工具配合，那它就没法开始。

现在我们已经接受了一个事实：对于很多工作流，使用 Granola 的最佳方式就是先捕获上下文，然后通过你的 internal agent 使用它。

sections.title: Refounding the Incumbent / 重做传统企业
sections.desc: AI 改造的难点不只是装上软件，而是重新安排人、流程、激励和资本的时间尺度。

cards.authorTag: Sequence Holdings Co-founder & CEO · No Priors

rewrite:
The takeaway: AI transformation works better when ownership, engineering talent, and the operating horizon are aligned. Sequence Holdings CEO Michael Lee argues that giving every employee a small machine is only the first step; companies need to reorganize around what always-on software can actually do.

His model is a permanent holding company that buys or partners with incumbents, then brings frontier engineers into the operating business. The point of ownership is not financial engineering. It gives the team permission to change incentives, workflows, and the organization itself. In BankSouth, the result was concrete: consumer-loan underwriting time fell 94%, while the average loan process went from 30 days to 11.

The memorable line is also the cultural thesis: “In a world where you believe that alpha comes from engineering and AI, you need to create a culture whereby the celebrated persona is the engineer.”
original: The right answer is to think about how do you start to reorganize what an organization should be to meet the opportunity of what's available to you with technology.
In a world where you believe that alpha comes from engineering and AI, you need to create a culture whereby the celebrated persona is the engineer.

What we've done now today is we've built a system that can take on all consumer loans within the organization. So the average consumer underwriting today has decreased by 94% since we got started in March.

rewrite:
核心结论是：AI 转型只有在所有权、工程人才和时间尺度对齐时，才可能真正发生。Sequence Holdings CEO Michael Lee 认为，给每个员工配一个小机器只是第一步，企业必须围绕 24/7 运转、可以持续扩展的软件能力，重新安排自己的组织。

Sequence 的做法是用永久控股公司的结构收购或合作传统企业，再把 frontier engineering 团队带进业务内部。所有权的价值不在财务工程，而在于它允许团队真正改动激励、流程和组织本身。BankSouth 的结果很具体：消费贷款 underwriting 时间下降了 94%，平均贷款流程从 30 天缩短到 11 天。

最能概括这套文化的一句话是：「如果你相信 alpha 来自 engineering 和 AI，就必须建立一种让 engineer 成为被尊敬核心的文化。」
original: 真正正确的答案，是重新思考一个组织应该是什么样，才能抓住技术已经提供给你的机会。
如果你相信 alpha 来自 engineering 和 AI，就必须建立一种让 engineer 成为被尊敬核心的文化。
我们现在已经构建了一个系统，可以处理组织里的所有消费贷款。自从 3 月开始，平均消费贷款 underwriting 时间下降了 94%。

rewrite: Box CEO Aaron Levie is seeing the first concrete shape of AI-created work. It includes applied AI engineers, forward-deployed engineers, deployment services, and existing data, research, and software roles moving into agent implementation. The important correction to the replacement story is that enterprises are not merely adding a chatbot; they are building the technical capacity to operate with agents.
original: AI requires significant technical work and surrounding services to deploy into the economy. This means jobs for AI engineers that build applied AI products sold to (or within) enterprises, FDEs to deploy agents into companies, new services firms for deploying AI, and more.

rewrite: Box CEO Aaron Levie 已经看到 AI 创造的新工作开始显形：applied AI engineer、负责把 agent 部署进企业的 FDE、新的部署服务公司，以及正在转向 AI 工作的数据、研究和软件岗位。这里的重要修正是，企业不是简单加一个 chatbot，而是在建立一套真正能和 agent 一起工作的技术能力。
original: AI 要进入经济，需要大量技术工作和周边服务。这意味着会出现为企业或企业内部构建 applied AI 产品的 AI engineer、把 agent 部署到公司的 FDE、新的 AI 部署服务公司，以及更多岗位。

sections.title: Infrastructure for Agent Speed / 为 agent 速度重做基础设施
sections.desc: 模型越来越快之后，真正拖慢体验的可能是 harness、依赖和存储，而不是模型本身。

rewrite: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch points to a less glamorous bottleneck: as models become faster, harness overhead matters more. Session storage, retrieval, and cloud durability start to determine the actual speed users feel, which is why the next layer of agent infrastructure is about reducing everything around the model.
original:
As models speed up (as with Astra 𝚞𝚕𝚝𝚛𝚊𝚏𝚊𝚜𝚝), harness overhead matters more and more.

Next release will feature even better performance for session storage and retrieval, and a big unlock for cloud durability in libfx.

rewrite: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 指出了一个不太显眼、但会越来越关键的瓶颈：模型变快之后，harness 的开销反而更值得关注。Session storage、retrieval 和 cloud durability 会决定用户真正感受到的速度，agent 基础设施的下一层竞争，就是把模型周围的一切都做得更轻。
original:
当模型变快（比如 Astra 𝚞𝚕𝚝𝚛𝚊𝚏𝚊𝚜𝚝）之后，harness 的开销越来越重要。

下一版会进一步提升 session storage 和 retrieval 的性能，并在 libfx 里解锁 cloud durability。

rewrite: Rauch's Rust migration story is a useful warning against treating language choice as ideology. Vercel moved Turborepo from Go to Rust for lower-level access, but the human migration cost was substantial. His conclusion is more interesting in the agent era: what is best for humans may no longer be what is best for the business, even though Rust itself may not be the final toolchain.
original:
The calculus has now changed. What's "best for humans" is no longer necessarily "best for business".

FWIW, it's also quite unlikely that Rust is the end-all-be-all toolchain. I'm quite certain there's greener pasture ahead, because Rust itself was designed before the 'supersonic tsunami' of agents hit.

rewrite: Rauch 分享的 Rust 迁移故事，提醒我们不要把语言选择变成意识形态。Vercel 把 Turborepo 从 Go 迁到 Rust，是因为它更适合底层 OS 访问，但人力迁移成本非常高。进入 agent 时代后，他的判断发生了变化：对人最友好的方案，不一定还是对业务最好的方案，不过 Rust 也未必就是终点，因为它本身是在 agent 的「超音速海啸」之前设计的。
original:
现在这笔账已经变了。「对人最好」不一定仍然是「对业务最好」。

顺便说，Rust 很可能也不是最终的 toolchain。我很确定前面还有更好的选择，因为 Rust 本身是在 agent 的「超音速海啸」出现之前设计的。

sections.title: The New Builder Surface / Builder 的新工作面
sections.desc: 工具变强之后，稀缺的不是“能不能做出来”，而是能否定义正确的问题、保持真实沟通，并把上下文交给 agent。

rewrite: Guillermo Rauch draws a clean boundary for AI-assisted communication: write READMEs, blogs, and tweets for humans, but let internal documentation speak in AI English for agents. The point is not style policing. Human-facing writing is where a story connects people; agent-facing documentation is an interface for machines.
original:
The 𝚁𝙴𝙰𝙳𝙼𝙴 is fully written by hand, because it's for human consumption. The documentation internals are AI English, because they're for agents.

Blogs, tweets, READMEs: human communication. It's not even about "em dashes" or lack thereof. It's that it's the story-telling moment where you want to connect with other humans through their words.

rewrite: Guillermo Rauch 给 AI 辅助写作划出了一条很清楚的边界：README、博客和 tweet 要为人写，内部文档则可以用 agent 更容易处理的 AI English。重点不是纠结文风，而是承认两种文本服务于两种接口：面向人的文字负责建立连接，面向 agent 的文档负责传递上下文。
original:
README 完全是手写的，因为它是给人看的。文档内部则是 AI English，因为它们是给 agent 用的。

博客、tweet、README 都是人与人的沟通。重点甚至不是有没有 em dash，而是这是你通过文字和其他人建立连接的讲故事时刻。

rewrite: Everyday AI interfaces may be entering a fast cycle of replacement. Dan Shipper says his persistent agent, Dot, has become his primary interface, but expects the product's personality to disappear once a more capable general assistant absorbs the same behavior. The lesson is that charming wrappers matter until capability becomes good enough to make the wrapper invisible.
original:
dot has become my primary interface to AI over the last few weeks.

in a year, i bet i'll still be interacting in this way with @ChatGPT—e.g. as an always-on persistent agent—but boo will have disappeared. it reminds me a lot of early OpenClaw days—we loved the little personality quirks of our Claws, but we dropped them as soon as there was something functionally more powerful available

rewrite: 日常 AI 界面可能会进入一个很快的替换周期。Dan Shipper 说，persistent agent Dot 已经成了他的主要 AI 入口，但他预计，一旦更强的通用助手吸收了同样的能力，Dot 的个性化外壳就会消失。这里的教训是：有趣的 wrapper 在能力还不够强时很重要，能力足够之后，最好的 wrapper 可能就是隐形的。
original:
过去几周，dot 已经成了我使用 AI 的主要界面。

我打赌一年后，我仍然会用这种方式和 ChatGPT 交互，比如把它当成一个一直在线的 persistent agent，但 boo 会消失。这让我想起早期 OpenClaw 的日子：我们喜欢 Claw 们的小个性，但一旦出现功能上更强的东西，我们很快就放弃了它们。
